name: ARQUE Systems
description: ARQUE Systems is a spin-off of Forschungszentrum Jülich and RWTH Aachen University developing semiconductor quantum computers based on electron spins in silicon. Its architecture couples qubits by shuttling electrons across the chip, an approach intended to support quantum error correction. Its first 5-qubit processor is deployed at the Jülich Supercomputing Centre in a hybrid system with NVIDIA DGX Quantum and Quantum Machines control hardware.

products.name: Spin-qubit quantum processor
products.description: Silicon electron-spin quantum processor using electron shuttling for qubit coupling; first generation has five qubits

highlights: Founded in September 2022 as a spin-off of Forschungszentrum Jülich and RWTH Aachen University (JARA Institute for Quantum Information)
5-qubit processor integrated with NVIDIA DGX Quantum and Quantum Machines OPX1000 at the Jülich Supercomputing Centre
Quantum chips fabricated on industrial wafers at Infineon Dresden
